title: A novel approach for preliminary sizing and cost screening of CO2 pipeline transport: The ECOB method
source: International journal of greenhouse gas control
summary: The study develops an Economic Operating Band (ECOB)-based framework for rapid CO2 pipeline sizing and transport cost screening. It targets early-stage CCS chain assessments where detailed diameter-by-diameter hydraulic optimisation is hard to embed and simple sizing rules miss the trade-off between investment and operating costs.
why_it_matters: Offers a fast pipeline sizing and cost-screening method that could be embedded in network optimisation models comparing pipeline and ship options.
authors: Binxu Gao, Nicola Zecca, Giampaolo Manzolini
approved_by: Published automatically (before the review step existed)
